split: fixed seed-42 10% physical-group carve from WED TRAIN
depth_route: calibrated MoGe only when measured ID 7 / 60 mm anchor is present; WED DEV no-card inputs use learned-weight path and do not run uncalibrated depth
mass_route: existing WED learned weight head for no-card mapped dishes; marker geometry path only on calibrated scenes

segmentation.region_matching: one-to-one class-aware connected-component IoU >= 0.5; WED components are semantic proxies, not serving instances

classification.metric_scope: pixel class accuracy/IoU and exact semantic class-set meals; no serving IDs exist in WED

weight.individual_class_total_granularity: WED labels one net gram total per food class per image; connected components are aggregated by class

runtime.resource_note: CPU inference; NVIDIA driver unavailable. Peak RSS is process high-water mark.
